text.text_excerpt: As a Marriott Rewards customer, I expected more! Ha, just kidding. I originally reserved a room for the Residence Inn on Joseph Street, but they were overbooked and placed me here and paid one night, breakfast, and one night of internet service. I was really satisfied with the way the situation was handled. I'm originally from the New Orleans area, but staying in a hotel downtown made it easier to navigate to VooDoo Fest in City Park :) Plus, Marriott hotels were the official hotels for VooDoo Fest, which meant there was a special rate: $169/night (originally ~$400?). The location is just great! Just minutes away from Canal Street, Bourbon, and French Quarter. The only downfall was the wa...

Great room. Good customer service from hotel staff. Everyone has been super nice. Very quiet part of town esp compared to other areas I visited while there. I hate that you need to park your car in their garage, but it was a business trip, so I didn't really need it. You can walk to most of the major tourist sites from this location.

This hotel is next to the convention center and a long walk from bourbon/Frenchmen/Jackson festivities. So be prepared to uber! The parking here is $50/ day OR you can self-park in the neighboring lot for $30. The rooms were spacious, clean, and updated. The bellhop and counter staff were amazing! They have a large public area with plenty of tables and chairs for lounging (OR for meeting Robert Irvine!!) They have a nice bar area, restaurant, and Starbucks all in the lobby!
